name: MonarchNotificationCenter
title: NotificationCenter
wrapsNative: MonarchTabs with androidx.compose.material3.Tab, androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn; MonarchInboxRow (MonarchListRow, SwipeToDismissBox), MonarchLoadMore, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchErrorState, MonarchEmptyState
summary: The in-app list of notifications: a heading with Mark all as read, All and Unread tabs, rows grouped under Today, Yesterday and dates, paging, and loading, error and empty states.
whenToUse: As the content of a MonarchBottomSheet or a screen opened from MonarchNotificationsBell, for the notifications the app keeps for each person.
whenNotToUse: For system notifications in the status bar, post them with NotificationManagerCompat; Monarch does not cover them. For a conversation list, use MonarchInboxRow in a LazyColumn. For a one-off message, use MonarchSnackbarHost or MonarchBanner.
api: @Composable fun MonarchNotificationCenter(items: List<MonarchNotificationCenterItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, unreadCount: Int? = null, initialFilter: MonarchNotificationCenterFilter = MonarchNotificationCenterFilter.All, now: Long? = null, loading: Boolean = false, errorMessage: String? = null, hasMore: Boolean = false, loadingMore: Boolean = false, loadMoreFailed: Boolean = false, groupByDay: Boolean = true, markReadOnSelect: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchNotificationCenterLabels = MonarchNotificationCenterLabels(), onFilterChange: ((MonarchNotificationCenterFilter) -> Unit)? = null, onMarkRead: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onMarkAllRead: (() -> Unit)? = null, onLoadMore: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchNotificationCenterItem) -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchNotificationCenterItem(id: String, title: String, time: Long, message: String? = null, read: Boolean = false, actorName: String? = null, actorImage: Painter? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, iconLabel: String? = null)

class MonarchNotificationCenterLabels(title: String? = null, all: String? = null, unread: String? = null, unreadTab: ((Int) -> String)? = null, markAllRead: String? = null, markRead: String? = null, unreadItem: String? = null, today: String? = null, yesterday: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, emptyUnreadTitle: String? = null, loading: String? = null, loadMore: MonarchLoadMoreLabels = MonarchLoadMoreLabels())

options.name: items
options.description: The loaded notifications, newest first.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the column. Give it a bounded height; the list scrolls.

options.name: unreadCount
options.description: The unread total from the server, which may exceed the loaded items. The unread loaded items by default.

options.name: initialFilter
options.description: The tab shown first. The component keeps the selection across configuration changes.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the compact ages and the day headings. Without it they read the clock.

options.name: loading
options.description: The first load: three placeholder rows from MonarchLoadingState.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The first load failed: MonarchErrorState with this title replaces the list.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: Another page exists: MonarchLoadMore ends the list when onLoadMore is given.

options.name: loadingMore
options.description: A page is loading.

options.name: loadMoreFailed
options.description: The last page failed; the load-more row offers a retry.

options.name: groupByDay
options.description: Groups items under Today, Yesterday and dates, in the device's time zone.

options.name: markReadOnSelect
options.description: Calls onMarkRead when an unread item is opened.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the load-more row's.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Receives the tab, for apps that fetch each tab from the server.

options.name: onMarkRead
options.description: Marks one item read. Adds a swipe toward the end and a TalkBack action on unread items.

options.name: onMarkAllRead
options.description: Adds Mark all as read to the heading row, disabled when nothing is unread.

options.name: onLoadMore
options.description: Loads the next page; also retries a failed page.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries a failed first load.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: An item was opened. Navigate to what it is about.

options.name: footer
options.description: Content after the list, such as a link to notification settings.

states.name: unread item
states.description: An accent dot before a semibold title and a stronger age, from MonarchInboxRow; TalkBack reads Unread.

states.name: unread tab
states.description: Only unread items; the tab shows the unread count in an info badge, 99+ above 99.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholder rows, read as Loading notifications.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchErrorState with the message and Try again.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState: You're all caught up, or No unread notifications in the Unread tab.

states.name: loading more
states.description: MonarchLoadMore at the end of the list in its loading or failed state.

states.name: nothing unread
states.description: Mark all as read is disabled.

appearance: The heading is default text in the heading style; day headings are muted captions. The tabs are the Material 3 primary tab row in the Monarch theme, and the unread count is an info badge. Rows are MonarchInboxRow on the surface color, with the accent unread dot. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web component is a bell that opens a popover. On Android the bell is MonarchNotificationsBell and the list is this component, placed by the app in a MonarchBottomSheet or a screen, because a popover from a bell is a sheet on a phone; iOS presents it in a sheet with its own navigation bar and a Done button, which Android does not need since sheets and screens close with the system back gesture. Marking one item read is a swipe toward the end, also a TalkBack action, instead of a per-row button. Rows reuse MonarchInboxRow, so titles and messages are cut to one line each and ages are compact (5m, 3h). Items have no href: onSelect navigates. A custom empty state and a custom trigger are not offered. The unread count uses the accent tone, as on the web. The tab parameter is initialFilter, because the component keeps the selection (iOS names it filter); groupByDay and markReadOnSelect follow the Android naming of MonarchActivityTimeline. Without now, day headings are computed when the list composes and do not change at midnight while it stays open. Experimental: a domain pattern until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The tabs are Material 3 Tabs; the Unread tab is read as Unread, with the unread total.
The heading has the heading role, and so do the day headings.
Each item is one MonarchInboxRow element read as the title, Unread when unread, the full date and time, and the message.
The unread dot is not read; the state is spoken, and shown by a semibold title as well as the color.
Mark as read is a TalkBack custom action on unread items as well as a swipe.
The loading placeholder is one element named Loading notifications.
Rows, tabs, Mark all as read and Load more have touch targets of at least 48dp and grow at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A server unread count of 120 shows 99+ but TalkBack reads 120.
A negative unreadCount is treated as zero.
An item marked read while the Unread tab is shown leaves the tab, because the tab filters the items the app passes.
Items that are not newest first start a new day heading each time the day changes.
With hasMore but no onLoadMore, no load-more row is shown.

examples.setupTemplate:
var read by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf<String>()) }
val items = listOf(
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.0.id}},
        title = {{items.0.title}},
        time = {{items.0.time|millis}},
        message = {{items.0.description}},
        read = {{items.0.id}} in read,
        actorName = {{items.0.actor}},
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.1.id}},
        title = {{items.1.title}},
        time = {{items.1.time|millis}},
        read = {{items.1.id}} in read,
        actorName = {{items.1.actor}},
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.2.id}},
        title = {{items.2.title}},
        time = {{items.2.time|millis}},
        message = {{items.2.description}},
        read = {{items.2.id}} in read || {{items.2.read}},
        actorName = {{items.2.actor}},
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.3.id}},
        title = {{items.3.title}},
        time = {{items.3.time|millis}},
        read = {{items.3.id}} in read || {{items.3.read}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bell, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
    ),
)
